resources.string: Health Connect delivers no body measurements, so Apex has none yet. Import a Google Takeout archive to add your weigh-ins and body fat.
Open Takeout import to add your weigh-ins
Demo mode keeps its own data, so Takeout import is off while it is on.
No readings in this range yet.
BMI is calculated from each weigh-in and your height.
Weight and body fat are shown as delivered, with where they came from. A weight you typed in Profile is labelled self-reported and has no date.
BMI is weight divided by height squared. Apex calculates it only when it has both, and never guesses a height.
BMI is a rough ratio. It says nothing about muscle or fat.
